# NEW 2026-11-21 v7.2 Stage 3 Package 1A, Restored Yuan vs Timur (oe_ytm_, slot 51). Generated by gen_yuan_timur.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Any scope, monthly: called by scheduler slot 51 (gen_mainline_lock.py) or fallback pulse (oe_ytm_pulse.txt).
# Idempotent per calendar month via oe_ytm_ran_m.
oe_ytm_monthly = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_m value = oe_ytm_m_now }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_ytm_ran_m ?= global_var:oe_ytm_m } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_ran_m value = global_var:oe_ytm_m }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ytm_init } } oe_ytm_setup = yes }
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ytm_on }
            oe_ytm_end_check = yes
            if = {
                limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ytm_on current_date >= 1370.1.1 }
                oe_ytm_ev_step = yes
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_dbg_n_y1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_y1n value = global_var:oe_dbg_n_y1 } }
    }
}
# Any scope. First run: before 1430.1.1 while Mongol Yuan stands, arm the line (events open from 1370.1.1).
oe_ytm_setup = {
    set_global_variable = oe_ytm_init
    if = {
        limit = { current_date < 1430.1.1 oe_ytm_yuan_ok = yes }
        set_global_variable = oe_ytm_on
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_done value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_stance value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_tarim value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_otrar value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_hexi value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_road value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_shah_rukh value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_legacy value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_readiness value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_wait value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_last value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_sent_cnt value = 0 }
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_done value = 8 }
    }
}
# Any scope (F6 COLLAPSE_HOOKS interface for gen_yuan_y3.py; also checked monthly).
oe_ytm_on_yuan_fall = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ytm_on } oe_ytm_finish = { code = 2 } }
    else = { oe_ytm_strip = yes }
}
# Any scope. Monthly end checks: 2 Yuan fell, 1 completed via .8, 3 reached 1430.1.1.
oe_ytm_end_check = {
    if = { limit = { oe_ytm_yuan_ok = no } oe_ytm_on_yuan_fall = yes }
    else_if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_ytm_done ?= 1 }
        remove_global_variable = oe_ytm_on
    }
    else_if = { limit = { current_date >= 1430.1.1 } oe_ytm_close_timeout = yes }
}
# Any scope. Strip modifiers and close with code.
oe_ytm_finish = {
    oe_ytm_strip = yes
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ytm_on } remove_global_variable = oe_ytm_on }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_done value = $code$ }
}
oe_ytm_close_timeout = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ytm_on } remove_global_variable = oe_ytm_on }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_done value = 3 }
}

    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ytm_sent_cnt } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_sent_cnt value = 0 } }
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_sent_cnt add = 1 }
}

# Any scope, monthly from 1370.1.1. Lapses missed windows and sends at most one event per month (shared oe_yuan_ev_m guard).
oe_ytm_ev_step = {
    if = { limit = { oe_ytm_lapse_1 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_st_1 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_ytm_lapse_2 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_st_2 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_ytm_lapse_3 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_st_3 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_ytm_lapse_4 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_st_4 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_ytm_lapse_5 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_st_5 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_ytm_lapse_6 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_st_6 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_ytm_lapse_7 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_st_7 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_ytm_lapse_8 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_st_8 value = 2 } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_pick value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ytm_wait } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_wait value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { oe_ytm_busy = no global_var:oe_ytm_wait >= 2 } }
        if = { limit = { oe_ytm_due_4 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_pick value = 4 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ytm_due_5 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_pick value = 5 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ytm_due_2 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_pick value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ytm_due_3 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_pick value = 3 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ytm_due_6 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_pick value = 6 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ytm_due_7 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_pick value = 7 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ytm_due_8 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_pick value = 8 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ytm_due_1 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_pick value = 1 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_ytm_pick ?= 0 oe_ytm_busy = no }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ytm_pick ?= 0 oe_ytm_open_1 = yes } random = { chance = 10 set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_pick value = 1 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ytm_pick ?= 0 oe_ytm_open_2 = yes } random = { chance = 12 set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_pick value = 2 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ytm_pick ?= 0 oe_ytm_open_3 = yes } random = { chance = 12 set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_pick value = 3 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ytm_pick ?= 0 oe_ytm_open_4 = yes } random = { chance = 24 set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_pick value = 4 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ytm_pick ?= 0 oe_ytm_open_5 = yes } random = { chance = 16 set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_pick value = 5 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ytm_pick ?= 0 oe_ytm_open_6 = yes } random = { chance = 12 set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_pick value = 6 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ytm_pick ?= 0 oe_ytm_open_7 = yes } random = { chance = 12 set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_pick value = 7 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ytm_pick ?= 0 oe_ytm_open_8 = yes } random = { chance = 14 set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_pick value = 8 } } }
    }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ytm_pick ?= 0 oe_ytm_busy = yes oe_ytm_any_due = yes } change_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_wait add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ytm_pick ?= 1 } oe_ytm_fire_1 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ytm_pick ?= 2 } oe_ytm_fire_2 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ytm_pick ?= 3 } oe_ytm_fire_3 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ytm_pick ?= 4 } oe_ytm_fire_4 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ytm_pick ?= 5 } oe_ytm_fire_5 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ytm_pick ?= 6 } oe_ytm_fire_6 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ytm_pick ?= 7 } oe_ytm_fire_7 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ytm_pick ?= 8 } oe_ytm_fire_8 = yes }
    remove_global_variable = oe_ytm_pick
}

oe_ytm_test_ensure = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ytm_on } } oe_ytm_setup = yes }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ytm_on } } set_global_variable = oe_ytm_on set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_done value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_stance value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_tarim value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_otrar value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_hexi value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_road value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_shah_rukh value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_legacy value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_readiness value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_wait value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_last value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_sent_cnt value = 0 } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_m value = oe_ytm_m_now }
}
